extracted.name: Quiche lorraine
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member bakingchef15 and has not been tested by our team.
instruction_lines: Line a 18cm (7inch) flan dish or sandwich tin with pastry.
Place half the cheese in the pastry case and cover with bacon.
Beat the eggs and milk together, season and pour over cheese and bacon. Sprinkle on remaining cheese.
Bake for about 40 min until set and golden brown.
